import csv
from decimal import Decimal

# Invoice data extracted from PDFs
invoices = {
    '002071': {
        'vendor': 'Delta Studio Supply',
        'items': [
            ('Archive cartons, reinforced - batch 2', 9, '12.45', '112.05'),
            ('Labels "Handle with care", roll 2', 3, '10.80', '32.40'),
            ('Cut-to-length protective liner, grade 2', 2.5, '14.76', '36.90'),
            ('Returned labels credit, order 2', 1, '-9.80', '-9.80'),
        ],
        'tax': '22.17',
        'total': '193.72'
    },
    '002082': {
        'vendor': 'Elm Fabrication Ltd',
        'items': [
            ('Bench assembly, series 2', 2, '1262.60', '2525.20'),
            ('Alignment service, station 2', 1.5, '86.40', '129.60'),
            ('Replacement seal kit for hydraulic assembly, series 2, including mounting collars and protective sleeves; compatible with the extended housing and supplied with inspection certificate', 3, '49.75', '149.25'),
            ('Precision shims, pack 2', 7, '4.375', '30.63'),
            ('Freight and handling, zone 2', 1, '42.50', '42.50'),
            ('Volume discount, agreement 2', 1, '-36.00', '-36.00'),
        ],
        'tax': '154.28',
        'total': '2995.46'
    },
    '002093': {
        'vendor': 'Firth Survey Services',
        'items': [
            ('Site survey, area 2', 1, '448.50', '448.50'),
            ('Travel time, route 2', 2.25, '64.80', '145.80'),
            ('Calibration standard, set 2', 2, '37.25', '74.50'),
            ('Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 2', 4, '18.95', '75.80'),
            ('Cable assemblies, shielded, length 2 m', 5, '11.40', '57.00'),
            ('Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2', 1, '-26.00', '-26.00'),
        ],
        'tax': '90.64',
        'total': '866.26'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        vendor = data['vendor']
        for description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount in data['items']:
            writer.writerow([invoice_id, vendor, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount])

print("Created items.csv")

# Reconciliation
reconciliation = []
for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
    # Calculate subtotal from line items
    subtotal = sum(Decimal(item[3]) for item in data['items'])
    tax = Decimal(data['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(data['total'])
    computed_total = subtotal + tax
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'subtotal': subtotal,
        'tax': tax,
        'printed_total': printed_total,
        'computed_total': computed_total,
        'difference': difference,
        'status': status
    })

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for rec in reconciliation:
        writer.writerow([
            rec['invoice_id'],
            rec['subtotal'],
            rec['tax'],
            rec['printed_total'],
            rec['computed_total'],
            rec['difference'],
            rec['status']
        ])

print("Created reconciliation.csv")

# Report discrepancies
discrepancies = [r for r in reconciliation if r['status'] == 'discrepancy']
if discrepancies:
    print("\n⚠️  DISCREPANCIES FOUND:")
    for rec in discrepancies:
        print(f"  Invoice {rec['invoice_id']}: difference = {rec['difference']}")
else:
    print("\n✓ All invoices reconciled successfully - no discrepancies found")
EOF

    },
    '002082': {

        'items': [

            ('Replacement seal kit for hydraulic assembly, series 2, including mounting collars and protective sleeves; compatible with the extended housing and supplied with inspection certificate', 3, '49.75', '149.25'),
            ('Precision shims, pack 2', 7, '4.375', '30.63'),
            ('Freight and handling, zone 2', 1, '42.50', '42.50'),
            ('Volume discount, agreement 2', 1, '-36.00', '-36.00'),
        ],
        'tax': '154.28',
        'total': '2995.46'
    },
    '002093': {
        'vendor': 'Firth Survey Services',
        'items': [
            ('Site survey, area 2', 1, '448.50', '448.50'),
            ('Travel time, route 2', 2.25, '64.80', '145.80'),
            ('Calibration standard, set 2', 2, '37.25', '74.50'),
            ('Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 2', 4, '18.95', '75.80'),
            ('Cable assemblies, shielded, length 2 m', 5, '11.40', '57.00'),
            ('Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2', 1, '-26.00', '-26.00'),
        ],
        'tax': '90.64',
        'total': '866.26'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        vendor = data['vendor']
        for description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount in data['items']:
            writer.writerow([invoice_id, vendor, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount])

print("Created items.csv")

# Reconciliation
reconciliation = []
for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
    # Calculate subtotal from line items
    subtotal = sum(Decimal(item[3]) for item in data['items'])
    tax = Decimal(data['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(data['total'])
    computed_total = subtotal + tax
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'subtotal': subtotal,
        'tax': tax,
        'printed_total': printed_total,
        'computed_total': computed_total,
        'difference': difference,
        'status': status
    })

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for rec in reconciliation:
        writer.writerow([
            rec['invoice_id'],
            rec['subtotal'],
            rec['tax'],
            rec['printed_total'],
            rec['computed_total'],
            rec['difference'],
            rec['status']
        ])

print("Created reconciliation.csv")

# Report discrepancies
discrepancies = [r for r in reconciliation if r['status'] == 'discrepancy']
if discrepancies:
    print("\n⚠️  DISCREPANCIES FOUND:")
    for rec in discrepancies:
        print(f"  Invoice {rec['invoice_id']}: difference = {rec['difference']}")
else:
    print("\n✓ All invoices reconciled successfully - no discrepancies found")
EOF
